items.title: 8.10 Equilibrium ki position aur reaction ke halaat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.10, printed page 179.

blocks.text: Equilibrium ki position equilibrium mixture mein products aur reactants ki nisbati miqdarein hai. Jab equilibrium par system ko chhera jaye to position badal sakti hai: agar reactants ke muqable products ki concentration barhe to position daen shift hui hai (print baen kehti hai); agar reactants ke muqable products ki concentration ghate to woh baen shift hui hai (print daen kehti hai).

blocks.prompt: Equilibrium par N2, H2 aur NH3 ka mixture dabaya jata hai aur ammonia ka tanasub barhta hai. Equilibrium ki position kis simt shift hui, aur kya Kc badla?
blocks.explanation: Products ki taraf, daen, kyunke ammonia ka tanasub barha hai. Kc be-tabdeel hai: sirf darja hararat use badal sakta hai; dabao ki tabdeeli ne concentrations yun badlin ke un ka tanasub wahi Kc de.

items: Equilibrium ki position: products aur reactants ki nisbati miqdarein; daen shift ka matlab zyada products, baen zyada reactants (print ke dono bayan ulte hain).
